resources.title: Social Media Character Limits
resources.content: Twitter: 280 chars. Instagram: 2,200 caption, 30 hashtags. LinkedIn: 3,000 post, 120 headline. Facebook: 63,206 post. TikTok: 2,200 caption.

resources.title: Hashtag Best Practices
resources.content: Instagram: 5-10 hashtags optimal. Mix popular (1M+), medium (100K-1M), and niche (<100K). Twitter: 1-2 hashtags. LinkedIn: 3-5 professional tags.

resources.title: Engagement Boosting Tactics
resources.content: Ask questions in captions. Use polls and quizzes. Share behind-the-scenes content. Create saveable infographics. Host giveaways. Go live regularly. Respond to comments quickly.

resources.title: Social Media Crisis Response
resources.content: 1. Acknowledge quickly (within 1 hour). 2. Take conversation offline if needed. 3. Never delete negative comments. 4. Respond with empathy. 5. Provide clear next steps. 6. Follow up publicly when resolved.
